ceu: ✦ The opposition between Mercury and Saturn

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between relationships and your image. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between romance and friendships. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between family and your career. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between money and intimacy. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between your image and relationships. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between friendships and romance. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between your career and family. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
Until {H:1821693733000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up home and family.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between intimacy and money. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.
